instructions: Populate every case only after executing it on the target machine; simulated or automated evidence must not be marked manual_pass. Use tools/manual_evidence.py to validate or atomically record outcomes.

cases.name: supervisor and startup
exact_steps: From the repository root, launch start_focuscheck.bat and record the supervisor and child PIDs.
Confirm the canonical data root contains a current heartbeat and supervisor log.
Persist manual pause, relaunch normally, and confirm pause is preserved; relaunch once with --force-start and confirm the override is invocation-scoped.
Start a second supervisor and confirm it exits without launching a duplicate child.
Use tray Exit and confirm the child exits without supervisor restart.
Enable and disable supervised startup, then inspect HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run for the canonical supervisor command and base directory.
cases.expected: Normal launch preserves durable pause, force-start is explicit, duplicate supervisors are rejected, tray Exit is acknowledged without restart, and startup registration targets the canonical supervisor and data root.

cases.name: tray and Tk UI
exact_steps: With the app supervised and visible in the Windows tray, open Prompt Now, Snooze, Settings, Logs, Data Folder, startup toggle, and Exit.
Toggle Pause and Resume and confirm the enabled action matches manual intent, not guard or snooze pause.
Open Settings, change one numeric and one boolean value, save, restart, and confirm both values persist.
Open a V1 prompt and exercise studying, wasting, Escape/close, challenge failure, and detail interruption paths.
Close the app with each reminder or prompt surface open and confirm no orphan window or tray process remains.
cases.expected: Every tray command reaches the intended surface, enabled states reflect authoritative runtime intent, settings persist durably, prompt validation/close paths are explicit, and shutdown leaves no owned UI resources.

cases.name: lock sleep resume
exact_steps: Enable and disable pause-on-lock, pause-on-idle, pause-on-lid, and pause-on-sleep settings one at a time.
Lock and unlock Windows, then sleep and resume Windows, observing the prompt, tray state, heartbeat pause reason, and next scheduled prompt.
Repeat with a manual pause and with an active snooze to confirm guard transitions do not erase manual intent or snooze expiry.
After resume, confirm the supervisor and child remain healthy and no duplicate prompt or reminder appears.
cases.expected: Configured native session/idle transitions pause and resume coherently, preserve manual intent and snooze state, publish the correct reason, and do not leak prompts, reminders, or processes.

cases.name: browser flags and overlays
exact_steps: In V2 mode, configure exact, subdomain, severity 1/2/3, cooldown, allow-once, and suffix-attack website flags.
Visit matching and non-matching pages in each supported browser family: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Opera GX, and Firefox.
Verify URL query/fragment handling, title-only fallback, stale/provider-error suppression, cooldown, and allow-once behavior.
Exercise Yes, No, Escape, cancellation, spotlight, blackout, stage 5 dimming, click-through, Enter, and multi-monitor positioning.
Capture screenshots and sanitized logs for every browser/overlay result.
cases.expected: Only authoritative matching activity triggers the configured intervention severity; cooldown and cancellation semantics are correct, and overlays restore focus/display state on every completion or interruption.

cases.name: packaging install upgrade uninstall
exact_steps: Build a fresh PyInstaller package and validate both frozen executables and the package manifest.
Install into a disposable directory with a separate disposable data root and record the manifest hashes.
Upgrade to a second package, confirm the previous package backup is retained, then exercise rollback.
Uninstall and confirm binaries are archived while the data root and user settings/tasks remain intact.
If a signing certificate is available, rerun validation with -RequireSigned and record Authenticode results.
Record package version, machine, exact commands, logs, and any installer/startup evidence.
cases.expected: Install, upgrade, rollback, and uninstall are reversible and data-safe; package hashes validate, signing status is explicit, startup routes to the installed supervisor, and no user data is deleted.
